inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Iron links, cold steel breath
Chains that hold, now cut the death
Stone by stone, the wall exhales
Grey dust hangs in stagnant halls
We pull the weight, we drag the rust
Turn the shackles into dust

[Chorus]
Break the grey
Break the gaze
Concrete burns, the silence dies
Concrete Rebellion

[Verse]
Eyes of wire, watching deep
Now they blink in shattered sleep
Hands that bled, now hands that tear
Strip the city of its stare
The watchtower falls in two
Hollow light lets shadows through

[Chorus]
Break the grey
Break the gaze
Concrete burns, the silence dies
Concrete Rebellion

[Bridge]
One stone loose, the others groan
Weight of years, finally gone
The last link snaps, the floor gives way
We stand tall in the dust of day

[Solo]

[Chorus]
Break the grey
Break the gaze
Concrete burns, the silence dies
Concrete Rebellion

[Outro]
The wall is down
The city is found
Chains are gone
We are not strong
